claims.quote: GABAergic (GABRA1, GABRB1) gene expression altered by PTZ administration

prior administration of Bacillus safensis NMCC-189 and Bacillus clausii successfully restored the expression of tight junction (ZO-1, Occludin, Claudin), and normalized glutamatergic (NR1, NR2A, NR2B, mGluR1, GluA1, GluA2) and GABAergic (GABRA1, GABRB1) gene expression altered by PTZ administration
